setupDescription: Create the first account. It will be the administrator's, who creates the other users.
signInDescription: Sign in with the e-mail and password of your account.
changePasswordRequired: Your password is temporary: choose your own before going on.
changePasswordDescription: Other devices signed in to your account will be signed out.
changePasswordResetOn: The administrator reset your password on {date}.
changePasswordRecoveredOn: Your password was reset from the server on {date}.
usersDescription: Everyone with an account on this installation.
usersCreateDescription: They will choose their own password at their first sign-in.
usersCreated: {name} can now sign in with the temporary password.
usersResetDescription: They will choose their own at their next sign-in. Every device signed in to their account is signed out, AI agents included.
usersResetDone: {name} must now sign in with the temporary password.
errorTooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errorSignUpClosed: Sign-up is closed: ask the administrator for an account.
errorPasswordTooShort: The password needs at least {min} characters.
errorPasswordTooLong: The password can have at most {max} characters.
errorPasswordUnchanged: The new password must differ from the current one.
errorEmailTaken: An account already uses this e-mail.
errorSignInRequired: Your session has ended: sign in again.
errorAdminOnly: Only the administrator can do this.
errorUserNotFound: This user no longer exists. Reload the page.
errorCannotResetAdministrator: The administrator changes their own password from their account menu.
consentOrigin: It comes from {client} and will be sent back to {back}.
consentUnknownOrigin: It will be sent back to {back}.
consentWriteSummary: With write, it can change your data as you would
consentWriteDetail: Add or edit an account, import a statement, undo an import, note a balance. Allow read only unless you want it to act for you.
consentRevoke: You can revoke it at any time in {place}. Revoking cuts it off at once.
mcpClientsDescription: The AI agents and apps you allowed to reach your data over MCP, at {endpoint}. Revoking one cuts it off at once.
mcpRevoked: {client} can no longer reach your data.
mcpDoorOpen: Every user can connect AI agents to their own data.
mcpDoorClosed: MCP access is turned off: no AI agent can reach this installation.
mcpDoorUnavailable: MCP access needs Gousset to be served over HTTPS, or on this machine (localhost). Serve it over HTTPS to turn it on.
notFoundDescription: The address may be mistyped, or the page has moved.
reviewEmptyTitle: Your review starts with your first import
reviewEmptyDescription: Import a statement from your bank: the review reads its lines month by month. An account is made as you import, or add yours first.
reviewOtherCurrency: In {currency}: received {received}, spent {spent}, set aside {setAside}, left {left}
reviewMovementsAside: money in, and between your accounts
reviewMovementsEmpty: No money came in or moved this month.
reviewFlagsEmpty: Nothing to point out this month.
reviewFlagStopped: {merchant} was expected on {day} and did not come; last paid {amount} on {last}
reviewFlagImportedNone: {account} has no statement imported for the month
reviewProposalDuplicate: Discard it: it repeats the line of {day}, {label}, {amount}.
reviewProposalDuplicateGone: Discard it: it was held as a repeat of a line that is no longer there.
reviewProposalTransfer: Pair it as a transfer with the line of {day} on {account}, {amount}.
reviewProposalRefund: Link it as a refund of the expense of {day}, {label}: {category}, costing {amount}.
reviewProposalNoCategory: Choose the category it goes in.
reviewRefusalChanged: Its proposal changed meanwhile: here is the new one.
reviewRefusalNotHeld: This line is no longer held as a repeat.
reviewRefusalCannotPair: The transfer cannot be paired as proposed any more: choose its other side below.
reviewRefusalCannotLink: This refund cannot be linked as proposed any more: see the expenses below.
reviewRefusalCategoryRequired: Choose the category it goes in.
reviewKept: Kept: it counts now. Its category is still to review.
operationsEmptyDescription: Every line of every account will be listed here, from your first imported statement.
operationsAmountRefused: Type an amount as 12.50; the least cannot be above the greatest.
operationsPeriodRefused: This period cannot be read: its first day must come before its last.
operationsTransferLineGone: This line is no longer there: it was removed meanwhile.
operationsTransferAlreadyPaired: One of these lines is already a side of a transfer.
operationsTransferCannotPair: These two lines cannot be the two sides of one transfer.
operationsTransferNotATransfer: This line is no longer a transfer.
operationsTransferFailed: The change could not be saved. Try again.
operationsLinkRefusedTransfer: A side of a transfer is never part of an expense: say it is not a transfer first.
operationsLinkRefusedSplit: A line split across categories joins no other expense: put it back in one category first.
operationsLinkRefusedLinked: That line is already part of another expense: separate it first.
operationsLinkRefusedAlreadyLinked: This line is already part of that expense.
operationsLinkRefusedExceeds: This refund is more than the expense still costs.
operationsLinkRefusedCurrency: The two lines are in different currencies: an expense is paid in one.
operationsLinkRefusedOther: These two lines cannot make one expense.
operationsSplitRefused: The split could not be saved: the shares must make the whole line, each in a category of its kind in use.
operationsExpenseNotLinked: This line is no longer part of an expense with other lines.
operationsFundRefusedNotFromBenefit: Only a transfer from a benefit account to an account of another kind funds an expense.
operationsFundRefusedNotAnExpense: That line is part of no expense this refund may fund.
operationsFundRefusedSplit: That line is split across several categories: put it back in one first.
operationsFundRefusedCurrency: That expense is in another currency than this refund.
operationsFundRefusedLater: That expense happened after this refund.
operationsFundRefusedOverCost: This refund is more than that expense still costs, its other refunds counted.
operationsFundRefusedAlreadyFunding: This refund funds another expense already: unfund it first.
operationsFundNotFunding: This refund funds no expense any more.
operationsTransferSameAccount: This line is on that account already: choose another account.
operationsTransferZeroAmount: A line of no amount cannot be a side of a transfer.
operationsTransferNotCounted: A line held for review cannot be paired: review it first.
operationsTransferMadeFromBalance: A movement made from a noted balance cannot be a side of a transfer.
operationsTransferKeptByLines: This account is kept by its lines: pair this line with the account's own line.
operationsTransferOtherCurrency: This account is in another currency than the line.
accountsEmptyDescription: Your bank accounts, savings, benefit cards and investment accounts will show here with their balance, from their first imported statement.
fieldOpeningBalanceInvalid: Enter the opening balance as a number, as 1234.56.
accountRefusalCurrencyLocked: The currency cannot change once the account has a line or a balance.
accountRefusalSettlesIntoRequired: Choose the current account this card settles into.
accountRefusalSettlesIntoOnlyForCard: Only a card settles into another account.
accountRefusalSettlesIntoNotOpen: Choose one of your open current accounts.
accountRefusalKeptByLines: This account is kept by its lines, not by a noted balance.
accountRefusalBalanceAlreadyNoted: A balance was already noted for that day.
accountRefusalDayRangeInvalid: Those days cannot be read together.
accountNotFoundDescription: It may have been removed, or the address is wrong.
accountCloseDescription: It keeps its lines and leaves the totals, shown apart in Closed accounts.
accountNoteBalanceDescription: This account is kept by its balance: note it from time to time.
accountLinesEmptyBalance: Nothing noted yet: note this account's balance below.
accountLinesOlderFailed: Older lines could not be loaded. Try again.
accountCreditOrderExpiringFirst: Soonest expiry first, as the issuer does
accountCreditExpiryDescription: Leave the day empty if it does not expire. The expiry moves no money: a line says when what expired leaves.
fieldTopUpDaysDescription: When the card cannot pay a whole purchase, its issuer charges the rest to your bank card: that line joins the purchase as one expense.
fieldTopUpCapDescription: The most the card pays a day. Leave it empty when you do not know it.
fieldTopUpCapInvalid: Enter an amount above zero, or leave it empty.
accountRefusalNotACredit: Only a credit of a benefit account has an expiry date.
accountRefusalExpiryBeforeCredit: A credit cannot expire before the day it was credited.
accountRefusalBalanceCategoryUnknown: This category no longer exists: choose another one.
accountRefusalBalanceCategoryArchived: This category is archived: choose one in use.
fieldBalanceCategoryDescription: Each noted balance makes one movement, put in this category.
investmentsEmptyDescription: Add a securities account, a PEA or a life insurance contract on the accounts page: what it holds and its operations will show here.
investmentsKeptByBalance: This account is kept by its balance: its operations are not entered one by one.
investmentsOlderFailed: Older operations could not be loaded.
investmentsEnterDescription: An operation on {name}, as the broker's statement writes it.
investmentsCorrectDescription: Its line on {name} changes with it.
investmentsDeleteDescription: {kind}, {day}, {amount}. Its line goes with it; if it was a transfer, the other account's line goes back to review.
investmentsDeleteFailed: The operation could not be deleted: {reason}
investmentsRefusalSign: This amount goes the wrong way for this kind of operation.
investmentsRefusalAmount: Enter an amount other than zero.
investmentsRefusalDay: Enter a day of the calendar.
investmentsRefusalQuantityRequired: A purchase and a sale need a quantity and a unit price.
investmentsRefusalQuantityNotAllowed: Only a purchase and a sale have a quantity and a unit price.
investmentsRefusalSecurityRequired: A purchase, a sale and a dividend name their security by its ISIN.
investmentsRefusalSecurityNotAllowed: A deposit and a withdrawal name no security.
investmentsRefusalCurrency: The security's currency is not a currency code.
investmentsRefusalInvalidIsin: This is not an ISIN: two letters, nine letters or digits, then its check digit. Check it for a typo.
investmentsRefusalInvalidQuantity: Enter a number above zero with at most 10 decimals, as 2,9791 or 2.9791.
investmentsRefusalInvalidPrice: Enter a number of zero or more with at most 10 decimals, as 112,4519 or 112.4519.
investmentsRefusalNotInvestment: Operations go on an investment account.
investmentsRefusalKeptByBalance: This account is kept by its balance: its operations are not entered one by one.
investmentsRefusalOperationNotFound: This operation no longer exists: it may have been deleted meanwhile.
subjectsEmptyDescription: A subject gathers the expenses of one thing across categories: a house, a van, a trip. Yours will be listed here.
importEmptyDescription: The bank statements you import will be listed here, with what each one added and what is left to check.
importDropDescription: OFX, QFX, QIF, CAMT.053, MT940 or CSV, up to 10 MB each. Several at once is fine.
importStepDeduplicate: Setting aside what is already known
importBalanceIgnored: This file's balance looks empty and was ignored: it says 0, while the account's lines make it something else that day.
importUndoneDescription: Lines removed: {removed}. Lines of other imports counted again: {givenBack}.
importUndoneTransfers: Transfers undone with them: {count}; their other sides wait to be paired again.
importUndoneOverlap: Later imports of this account overlap it: the lines they skipped as already known are gone too. Import this file again to bring them back.
importSameFile: {file} was already imported, on {date}: nothing is added twice.
importAccountQuestion: This file does not say which account it belongs to.
importAccountNone: You have no account yet: add one on the Accounts page, then try again.
importCsvIntro: Gousset could not tell everything about how this file is written. Choose a profile that reads it, or say what each column holds: the test read shows the lines as they will be imported.
importCsvNoRows: These settings find no line in the file: try another separator or encoding.
importCsvKindsEmpty: Choose the column that says what each row is: a purchase, a sale, a dividend… Its words are listed here, to say which is which. Without one, each row is a purchase or a sale by the sign of its quantity.
importOperationsNote: Read as a broker's operations with {profile}, into {account}.
importOperationsNoteByHand: Read as a broker's operations, into {account}.
importFailureNotInvestment: A broker's operations go into an investment account kept by its lines: choose one.
importFailureOperation: A row of the file is no operation Gousset can keep: an ISIN whose check digit is wrong, a quantity or an amount it cannot hold. Check the file is the broker's export, unchanged.
importCsvSkipRows: Lines to skip above the table
importCsvHeaderRow: The first line names the columns
importCsvMissingAmount: the amount, or the debit and the credit
importCsvRefusedValue: Line {line}, column {column}: “{text}” cannot be read as {field}. Check the column and the settings.
importCsvRefusedEmpty: Line {line}, column {column}: {field} is empty, and every line needs it.
importCsvRefusedTable: Line {line}: the table has fewer columns than those mapped, or none past the lines skipped. Check the separator and the lines to skip.
importCsvSaved: Saved as {name}: the next file with these columns is read with it.
importCsvImported: {name} is now one of your profiles.
importRefusedProfileNotFound: This profile is no longer there: choose another one.
importRefusedProfileUnreadable: This profile no longer reads: map the columns again, then save it.
importRefusedProfileFile: This file holds no profile Gousset reads: export one from Gousset, then import it.
importRefusedProfileTooMany: You already keep {limit} profiles, the most Gousset keeps.
importFailureNotAStatement: This file is not a statement Gousset can read in this format.
importFailureMalformed: The file is damaged or was cut short: download it again from the bank.
importFailureField: A value of the file cannot be read: download it again from the bank.
importFailureUnsupported: The file holds something Gousset does not import: several accounts, an investment statement, or lines in another currency.
importFailureCurrency: The file's currency is not its account's: choose an account in the same currency.
importFailureTooLarge: The file is over 10 MB: a statement is far smaller. Export a shorter period.
importFailureUnknownFormat: Gousset cannot tell this file's format: OFX, QFX, QIF, CAMT.053, MT940 or CSV.
importFailureUnavailable: The import could not start: try again in a moment.
importRefusedBusy: This import is still running, or was undone meanwhile: wait for it to end, then look again.
importRefusedNotFound: This import is no longer there: reload the page.
importRefusedAccount: This account is no longer there: choose another one.
importFailureReadTimeout: Reading the file took too long for a statement: export a shorter period from the bank.
importFailureReadCrashed: The file could not be read to its end: download it again from the bank, or export a shorter period.
importFailureOther: The file could not be imported. Try again; if it fails again, the app's log says why.
exportDescription: One archive (.zip) of everything you keep in Gousset: your accounts, their lines and balances, your imports with the files you imported, and your CSV profiles. Its JSON and CSV files open in any program, without Gousset; manifest.json says what each one holds. It holds your own data only: a backup of the whole installation is the administrator's, as Gousset's documentation says.
settingsLanguageDescription: The language of the interface on this device. It follows your browser until you choose one.
settingsColorSchemeDescription: Follow the system, or keep the interface light or dark.
settingsSingleKeyShortcutsDescription: Shortcuts made of one key, like ? for the list of shortcuts. Speech input can press them by accident: turn them off, and the list stays in your account menu and on {keys}.
settingsCurrencyDescription: Your currency, the one the benchmarks you set are written in.
settingsPasswordDescription: The password you sign in with. Changing it signs out your other devices.
categoriesEmptyDescription: Your categories, on two levels, will be listed here with their monthly average and their benchmark.
categoriesDescription: Your expenses and income on two levels, each with its monthly average (over up to the last six full months) and its benchmark.
categoriesNoneArchived: No archived category. An archived category keeps its lines and can be restored here.
categoriesMoveDescription: Categories have two levels: a category goes at the top level or under a top-level category of its kind.
categoriesMergeDescription: Its lines go to the category you choose, its subcategories with them, and it is removed: this is how a category is deleted.
categoriesBenchmarkDescription: What its spending is compared with each month: its monthly average over up to the last six full months, an amount you set, or nothing.
categoriesArchiveDescription: Its lines keep it, but it can no longer be chosen; its subcategories are archived with it. You can restore it from Archived.
categoryRefusalNotFound: This category no longer exists. Reload the page.
categoryRefusalNameTaken: A category of this name is already at this level.
categoryRefusalThirdLevel: Categories have two levels only: a category cannot go under a subcategory, and one with subcategories stays at the top level.
categoryRefusalParentKind: An expense category and an income category cannot be mixed.
categoryRefusalItself: A category cannot go under itself, nor be merged into itself.
categoryRefusalArchived: This category is archived: restore it first.
categoryRefusalParentArchived: Its parent is archived: restore the parent first.
categoryRefusalFallback: “{name}” holds the lines not classified yet: it cannot be archived nor merged into another. Under a parent, move it to the top level before archiving or merging that parent.
categoryRefusalName: A name has 1 to 100 characters, without “>”.
categoryRefusalTooMany: You have 300 categories, archived ones included: merge some first.
categoryRefusalBenchmark: A benchmark is an amount from 0.
categoryRefusalKindMismatch: An expense goes in an expense category, an income in an income category.
categoryRefusalNotClassifiable: This line has no category to choose: it is held, discarded, split or of no amount.
merchantsDescription: Who you paid, recognised from the labels of your imported statements. Open one to rename it, merge it into another or move one of its labels.
merchantsEmptyDescription: Merchants come from your imports: each statement you import is read for who was paid, from its lines' labels. They will be listed here.
merchantsMoreFailed: More merchants could not be loaded. Try again.
merchantNotFoundDescription: It may have been merged into another one, or the address is wrong.
merchantLabelsDescription: The bank labels that name this merchant, as Gousset cleans them. A label that belongs to another shop can be moved there.
merchantLinesEmpty: No line of this merchant yet.
merchantMergeDescription: {name} disappears: its labels move to the merchant kept, and its lines with them.
merchantMoveDescription: Its lines go with it. A name no merchant has makes a new merchant.
merchantRefusalNotFound: This merchant no longer exists: it may have been merged. Go back to the list.
merchantRefusalNameTooLong: This name is too long: shorten it.
merchantRefusalNameTaken: {name} already has this name: merge this merchant into it instead.
merchantRefusalLabelNotFound: This label no longer names this merchant: reload the page.
merchantRefusalMergeIntoItself: Choose another merchant: a merchant is never merged into itself.
merchantRefusalMergeIntoUnknown: No merchant has this name: choose one of those offered.
merchantRefusalCategoryNotFound: This category no longer exists: reload the page.
merchantRefusalCategoryArchived: This category is archived: restore it first, or choose another.
merchantRefusalNotIntermediary: This line's label names no payment intermediary: its merchant is the label's. Mark that merchant as a payment intermediary first.
merchantRefusalNotOneEntry: Who was paid can only be set on a line counted whole as one expense or income: not on a line held for review, split or part of a transfer.
merchantRefusalIntermediaryChosen: {name} is a payment intermediary itself: choose who was really paid.
merchantIntermediaryDescription: Its labels hide who was paid: each of its lines asks for its merchant.
merchantDefaultDescription: The category this merchant's expenses, or incomes, go in by default.
merchantDefaultArchived: Archived: it can no longer be chosen. Choose another.
merchantDefaultSet: The default category of {merchant} is now {category}.
merchantDefaultCleared: {merchant} has no default category any more.
uiErrorTitle: This block could not be loaded
uiErrorMessage: Something went wrong on the way. The rest of the page still works.
uiChartEmpty: Nothing spent yet in this period.
rulesEmptyDescription: Rules classify your lines on import: if the label contains this, then this merchant and category. Most are born from a correction during the review.
uiAccountsBalanceAgrees: {app} in the app = {statement} on the statement of {day}.
uiAccountsBalanceDisagrees: {app} in the app, {statement} on the statement of {day}: a difference of {difference}.
uiAccountsBalanceAlsoDiffers: Also differs on these earlier statements:
uiAccountsCreditsEmpty: Nothing left on this account's credits.
uiOperationsMadeByApp: Made by Gousset: {account}'s statement does not show it
uiOperationsUnpairDescription: The two lines are no longer linked, and each counts on its own again.
uiOperationsUnpairDescriptionMade: The two lines are no longer linked, and the line Gousset made on {account} is deleted.
uiOperationsPairDescription: Choose the line that is its other side: once paired, neither counts as spending.
uiOperationsSeparateDescription: It leaves this expense and counts on its own again, in its default category until you choose another.
uiOperationsMaybeRefundDescription: This line may cancel all or part of an expense. Nothing changes until you confirm.
uiOperationsLinkAsRefundDescription: This line becomes a refund of {label}: that expense costs less, and this line no longer counts on its own.
uiOperationsLinkDescription: Choose a line of the expense: this line becomes one of its payments, or a refund when its money goes the other way.
uiOperationsFundsNone: A refund from a benefit account may fund one of your expenses, which keeps its cost.
uiOperationsFundsKept: The expense keeps its cost: the money becomes available.
uiOperationsFundDescription: Choose the expense this refund pays back, among those of the 90 days before it that cost at least as much.
uiOperationsFundNoCandidate: No expense of the 90 days before it costs at least this refund.
uiOperationsSplitDescription: Give each category its share: together, the shares make the whole line, {amount}.
uiOperationsSplitBalanced: The shares make the whole line.
uiOperationsWithBalanceAccount: With an account kept by its balance
uiOperationsPairWithAccountDescription: Choose the account kept by its balance this money went to or came from: Gousset makes its side, and neither counts as spending.
uiOperationsMerchantDescription: Paid through {intermediary}: choose the merchant behind it, or type a new name.
uiOperationsMerchantDescriptionPlain: Choose the merchant, or type a new name.
uiOperationsMerchantNew: A name not in the list makes a new merchant.
uiReviewCorrectDescription: The category {label} goes in, as your choice.
jobFailureInterrupted: The job was stopped before it finished: the app stopped, or it took too long. Try again.
jobFailureUnexpected: Something went wrong in the job. Try again; if it fails again, the app's log says where.
jobFailureInvalidInput: The job was sent something it cannot read. Start it again from its page.
jobFailureTest: The test job failed on purpose, as asked. Start it again with fewer failing attempts.
jobTestDescription: The end-to-end harness's job: it reports its steps, fails as often as asked, and touches a month.
jobsPanelDescription: Your last jobs and where each stands. Development only.
jobGoneDescription: It is not one of yours, it was removed some time after it ended, or your session has ended. Sign in again, or start it again from its page.
uiRulesMerchantNone: Left empty, each line keeps its merchant.
uiRulesCategoryArchived: {category} is archived: this rule classifies nothing new until you choose another.
uiRulesEnabledDescription: Off, it classifies no new line, and stays in its place.
uiRulesByHandOne: {count} of them was classified otherwise by hand.
uiRulesByHandOther: {count} of them were classified otherwise by hand.
uiRulesReachIncomplete: Complete the conditions to see the lines it applies to.
uiRulesApplyFailed: The rule could not be applied to the past: try again.
uiRulesSaveFirst: Save your changes before applying the rule.
uiRulesDeleteDescription: The lines it classified keep their category and merchant.
uiRulesCreatedByCorrection: Created on {day} while correcting a line
uiRulesProposalDescription: Lines whose label contains these words will go to {category} when they are imported.
uiRulesProposalDescriptionMerchant: Lines whose label contains these words will have {merchant} as their merchant when they are imported.
uiRulesProposalApplyOne: Also apply to the {count} line already there
uiRulesProposalApplyOther: Also apply to the {count} lines already there
uiInvestmentsFieldAmountPaid: What the cash paid, fees included.
uiInvestmentsFieldAmountReceived: What the cash received, fees taken off.
uiInvestmentsFieldAmountDividend: What was paid in, after tax.
uiInvestmentsFieldIsinHelp: Twelve letters and digits, as the statement writes it.
uiInvestmentsFieldIsinOptional: Only for a fee charged on one security.
uiInvestmentsFieldSecurityNameHelp: For a security new here; one already known keeps its name.
uiInvestmentsFieldDecimalHelp: With a comma or a point.
rulesDescription: Each new line goes to the first rule that applies to it, in this order.
rulesList: Rules, in the order they are tried
rulesApplyingToast: Applying the rule to the lines already there
ruleRefusalNotFound: This rule no longer exists: it was deleted.
ruleRefusalConditionsTooMany: A rule has {max} conditions at most.
ruleRefusalConditionInvalid: Condition {index} cannot be read: check its value, and that a range goes from the lowest to the highest.
ruleRefusalUnknownAccount: Condition {index} names an account you no longer have.
ruleRefusalNothingSet: Choose a merchant, a category, or both.
ruleRefusalCategoryArchived: This category is archived: choose another.
ruleRefusalMerchantIntermediary: This merchant is a payment intermediary: choose who was really paid.
ruleRefusalTooMany: You have {max} rules already: delete one first.
ruleRefusalJobUnavailable: The rule could not be applied now: try again in a moment.
